passCriteriaMet.objectOccupiesEnoughOfFrame: single wedge fills the frame with clear margin in all three views (see check_reference_admission for the measured fraction)
passCriteriaMet.strongSilhouette: unambiguous rounded-triangle wedge in top-down; wide-blob elevation is an expected consequence of the apex-forward pose, not a weak silhouette
passCriteriaMet.majorMaterialsVisible: single matte dielectric crust in two tonal zones (top vs everything else)
passCriteriaMet.hiddenSideInferable: underside is flat and occluded by the ground plane in every turntable azimuth above the horizon; no unresolved hidden geometry
passCriteriaMet.procedurallyApproximable: loft/extrude of a rounded-triangle outline plus displaced-grid fissures on the top face; no smoke, liquid, glass or lace anywhere

notConditional: three views supplied (three-quarter, front elevation, top-down); top-down is the authoritative footprint reference so the single-view caveat does not apply
stylizationLevel: low-poly faceted matte clay - explicitly the requested target, not a fallback
